name: Steak
description: fancy dinner that needs to be prepped beforehand. best temperature is always medium-rare
steps: Fully defrost the steak in the fridge
Let the steak come to room temperature for 30 min
Heat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Dry the steak, add oil and spices on both sides. Remember to add extra black pepper
Heat a dry frying pan until hot, add in cold oil.
Sear the steak on each side for 1 minute
Put the steak into the oven for 6.5 min
Take the steak off the pan and let the steak rest for 5 min before cutting
With the remaining oils, stir-fry onions with other vegetables or pan fry thick oyster mushrooms on low heat
notes: Technically supposed to bake steak for 6 min, but often ends up a bit rare if steak is thicker than 1 inch
